blocks.en: The raw-appearance difference between the two domains is quantified along three complementary axes in Fig. 5 B–D, computed on the un-warped, density-matched frame sets defined below. The per-pixel AoLP intensity distributions differ mainly in spread and mean (standard deviations σ syn = 48.6 \sigma_{\text{syn}}=48.6 versus σ real = 72.7 \sigma_{\text{real}}=72.7 on the 0 0 – 255 255 scale, and a per-frame mean offset of about + 58 % +58\% , Fig. 5 D); as analysed in the following paragraph, this absolute-value gap stems from the difference in background type between the simulated bare belt and the resin- and fiber-covered real line, together with a polarization reference-axis calibration offset, rather than from the rendered strip appearance. Because the strips occupy uncorrelated positions from frame to frame, a pixel-aligned structural-similarity index (SSIM) is intrinsically low even between two distinct real frames (median 0.10 0.10 ). The synthetic-to-real SSIM (median 0.13 0.13 ) is comparable to, and marginally above, this within-real reference floor (Fig. 5 C), while remaining well below the within-synthetic self-similarity (median 0.26 0.26 ); the cross-domain similarity is therefore on par with the intrinsic frame-to-frame similarity of the real process and is not inflated by the uniform synthetic background, an ordering preserved by a background-invariant Sobel-gradient SSIM (cross-domain 0.09 0.09 versus a within-real floor of 0.08 0.08 ).
blocks.zh: 两个域之间的原始存在差异在图5B-D中按照三个互补轴进行量化,按以下定义的未扭曲、密度匹配的框组计算。 每像素AOLP的强度分布主要在分布和平均值上有所不同(标准偏差==48.6\sigma_{\text{syn}}=48.6 相对实际=72.7\sigma_{\text{real}}=72.7). 如下段所分析,这一绝对值差距源于模拟光带与树脂和纤维覆盖的真线在背景类型上的差异,以及两极化参照轴校准偏移,而不是所形成的条形外观。 由于条条从帧到帧占据了不相关的位置,一个像素对齐的结构-等效指数(SSIM)内在较低,甚至在两个截然不同的真帧之间(中间值0.100.10 ). 合成至真实的SSIM(中间值为0.130.13)与这个真实内部参考底(图5 C)相当,略高于这个参考底(图5 C),但远远低于合成内部自我同质性(中间值为0.260.26);因此,跨域相似度与真实过程内在的帧与帧相似度相当,没有被统一的合成背景所膨胀,这是由背景内在的索贝尔渐变的SSIM(跨域为0.09,实际底为0.08)所维持的订单.

blocks.en: Because it needs neither pairing nor ground truth, the quantitative backbone of the evaluation is an unpaired comparison of appearance statistics computed over the synthetic image set against the real image set, density-matched to the high-coverage regime that the real frames occupy: the synthetic set comprises 150 150 AoLP renders whose simulated strip count lies in [ 450 , 1000 ] [450,1000] , and the real set comprises the 18 18 highest-coverage of the 23 23 available discrete-strip laboratory frames (the five sparsest, which contain too few strips for the comparison, are excluded). Edge and texture structure, quantified by the per-pixel Sobel gradient magnitude, gives a Kolmogorov–Smirnov distance of KS = 0.46 \text{KS}=0.46 between the two distributions, corresponding to a histogram overlap of 0.56 0.56 (Fig. 6 A); this is the smallest distance of the compared groups (a mismatched production-texture set gives KS = 0.66 \text{KS}=0.66 , overlap 0.35 0.35 ), and the synthetic edges are only marginally sharper in the extreme tail. The Kolmogorov–Smirnov distance is simply the largest vertical gap between the two empirical cumulative distribution functions; it describes how far apart two distributions lie and is neither a correlation nor a score with an intrinsic scale. It accordingly has no sample-size-independent acceptance threshold; the critical value of the distance shrinks with the two sample sizes as D α = c ⁡ ( α ) ​ 1 n + 1 m , D_{\alpha}=c(\alpha)\sqrt{\frac{1}{n}+\frac{1}{m}}, (19) where n n and m m are the sizes of the two samples and c ⁡ ( α ) c(\alpha) is the tabulated coefficient of the limiting distribution, c = 1.36 c=1.36 at the 5 % 5\% level [ 41 ] . For the pixel samples compared here Eq. ( 19 ) is of order 10 − 3 10^{-3} , and it remains orders of magnitude below every distance reported in this section even after allowing for the spatial correlation between neighbouring pixels, which reduces the effective sample size well below the nominal pixel count. Any two non-identical distributions are therefore separated at conventional significance, and statistical significance carries no information about fidelity here. The same sample-size sensitivity is documented for the distribution-level appearance metrics in common use for comparing image sets, whose values are biased and shift with the number of samples to the point of reordering the models being compared [ 42 , 43 ] ; such distances are consequently read against a reference measured under an identical protocol rather than against a fixed bound. We accordingly interpret ours against within- and between-domain references computed with the identical statistic, pixel sample, and histogram grid (Table 4 ). Two disjoint halves of a single real run differ by KS = 0.03 \text{KS}=0.03 (rising to 0.09 0.09 for a contiguous rather than an interleaved split), the repeatability floor under unchanged acquisition conditions, whereas two different real acquisition series of this same material, the discrete-strip laboratory run and the production run, differ by KS = 0.41 \text{KS}=0.41 (overlap 0.57 0.57 ). The synthetic-to-real distance of 0.46 0.46 (overlap 0.56 0.56 ) is thus of the same magnitude as the distance between two real recordings of the material: on this statistic the separation is dominated by acquisition conditions and scene type rather than by the synthetic origin of the images. Part of the residual distance is expected rather than a sign of mismatch: the perfectly flat synthetic surfaces drive the gradient magnitude toward zero in homogeneous regions, whereas real sensor noise produces small non-zero gradients even where the surface is uniform, so the two low-gradient tails cannot coincide exactly (consistent with Fig. 6 A). That the comparison is distributional rather than spatially registered is not a limitation here, because the strips occupy uncorrelated positions between frames, so a pixel-aligned edge comparison would be uninformative, and the two distributions agree most closely in the high-gradient edge range that carries the texture signal. The angle-of-linear-polarization channel faithfully encodes strip orientation: sampled at strip centroids across 40 40 frames ( n = 21,530 n=21{,}530 strips), the rendered AoLP correlates with the ground-truth oriented-box angle at r = 0.67 r=0.67 (Fig. 6 B), confirming that the polarization rendering carries the physical orientation signal rather than a constant or artifactual value. The synthetic strip orientations are themselves quasi-isotropic (orientation concentration r = 0.06 r=0.06 ), consistent with the fiber-orientation distribution reported above (Fig. 3 A). The remaining distributional discrepancies are characterized rather than attributed to strip appearance. The absolute AoLP value differs (Fig. 5 B; KS = 0.57 \text{KS}=0.57 ) largely because the polarization camera’s zero reference is its physical mounting angle, unrelated to the simulator’s coordinate frame: applying a single 120 ∘ 120^{\circ} reference-axis offset raises the AoLP distribution overlap from 0.31 0.31 to 0.60 0.60 , so a single calibration constant closes about half of the value gap and brings the cross-domain overlap to the level found between the two real acquisition series, whose AoLP distributions overlap one another by 0.66 0.66 . The real AoLP images additionally follow the Baumer camera’s standard false-color mapping, in which orientation is quantized into fixed one-degree intensity bins and every pixel below a degree-of-polarization threshold is set to the maximum value ( 255 255 , rendered white) rather than spanning the full available range; this convention concentrates real values near the top of the intensity scale, visible in Fig. 5 B, and is not reproduced by the linear synthetic mapping, which accounts for part of the absolute-value gap. The larger discrepancies in per-image mean and foreground-coverage fraction ( KS ≈ 0.94 \text{KS}\approx 0.94 ; nominal Otsu coverage ≈ 0.79 \approx 0.79 for synthetic versus ≈ 0.48 \approx 0.48 for the real set) reflect the same background-type and calibration differences rather than a difference in strip content. These last two figures are per-image statistics over the 18 18 real frames rather than pixel-level distributions, so the statistic is quantized in steps of 1 / 18 1/18 and is not on the same footing as the pixel-level distances above. This foreground statistic is moreover not directly comparable across the two domains, because Otsu thresholding selects the bright bare belt in the synthetic frames but the bright strips in the real frames; and the simulated bare conveyor belt is deliberately not intended to reproduce the resin- and fiber-covered real background. These are calibration and background effects rather than failures of the rendered strip appearance, whose edge and orientation structure matches.

blocks.en: The count probe provides an order-of-magnitude anchor on real data. Two real frames were exhaustively dot-counted by hand, counting a strip if any part of it is visible, giving 244 244 and 458 458 strips in a single 512 × 512 512\times 512 crop (Fig. 6 C). We deliberately keep this probe small. At this overlap the manual count is a lower bound with an estimated 10 10 – 20 % 20\% systematic undercount, because fully occluded strips cannot be seen (Fig. 6 C, inset); the error is systematic rather than random, so it does not diminish by averaging over more frames and it places a hard floor on any count-based real metric. This limitation is itself the central evidence for the approach: an exhaustive, amodal per-strip ground truth for several hundred densely overlapping strips cannot be obtained by manual annotation with any tool, which is precisely the labeling barrier that a simulator emitting exact labels removes.

blocks.en: As a label-free proxy for transfer, we examined the temporal consistency of the synthetic-trained CSRNet count on a steady real video sequence (Fig. 6 D). Across 30 30 consecutive frames (about 10 10 ms apart) and a further 20 20 frames strided across the run (about 1 1 s apart, 50 50 frames in total), the predicted count stays between 482 482 and 485 485 , a coefficient of variation of 0.001 0.001 : the model responds smoothly to real input rather than producing erratic or collapsed predictions. Because a model insensitive to its input would also be stable, we present this within-run stability as a label-free consistency check rather than a measure of accuracy; between-run discrimination on runs of differing density is a stronger test left to future multi-run evaluation.

blocks.en:
The one clearly visible appearance gap is that synthetic strip edges are cleaner than real edges, which carry fiber fray, defocus, and sensor noise. This is a standard and well-characterized target for data augmentation applied to the synthetic training data [ 44 ] : photometric and sensor-noise transformations (Gaussian, Poisson, and sensor noise; defocus and motion blur; brightness, contrast, and gamma jitter) together with edge-specific transformations (morphological erosion and dilation, elastic deformation, and feathered strip boundaries) reproduce these effects, and, more broadly, domain randomization over such appearance factors [ 45 ] and learned domain adaptation (for example Fourier-domain adaptation [ 46 ] , unpaired image-to-image translation [ 47 ] , or adaptive-instance-normalization style transfer [ 48 ] ) provide further routes should augmentation prove insufficient [ 49 ] .
Because the digital twin is fully automated, such refinements can be applied and the training set regenerated rapidly, at a fraction of the cost of collecting and labeling additional real data, turning real-world deployment from a one-time validation step into an iterative improvement loop.

由于数字双胞胎是完全自动化的,这种改进可以应用,训练集可以快速再生,成本是收集和贴上更多真实数据标签的一小部分,将现实世界的部署从一次性验证步骤转变为迭代改进循环.

blocks.en: These observations are consistent with the broader synthetic-to-real literature: synthetic data provides a strong initialization for perception models, with domain adaptation or a limited quantity of real labels closing the residual gap [ 28 , 49 , 50 ] . The distinctive point for this material is that exact labels for the densely overlapping-strip regime are obtainable only in simulation, so bootstrapping model development from synthetic data is not merely a convenience but the only scalable route to labeled training data at this scale.
blocks.zh: 这些观测结果与更广泛的合成对现实文献一致:合成数据为感知模型提供了强烈的初始化,域位调整或数量有限的真实标签关闭了剩余差距[28,49,50]. 这种材料的显著之处在于,只有模拟才能获得高度重叠的标记,因此,从合成数据中开发拖鞋模型不仅仅是一种方便,而且是在这个尺度上给培训数据贴标签的唯一可扩展路线。

blocks.en: 5.5 Answers to Research Questions
blocks.zh: 5.5 对研究问题的答复

blocks.en: This work addresses all three research questions through the development and validation of a process-informed, photorealistic digital twin for C-SMC strip deposition. Regarding the first research question on generating large-scale, fully annotated image datasets in silico , the developed simulation framework demonstrates the capability to produce over 16,000 16{,}000 images across more than 3,300 3{,}300 measurement frames with comprehensive annotations, capturing meso- and macro-scale fiber-arrangement variability through rigid-body strip deposition dynamics that incorporate gravitational settling, friction, and belt motion; this variability is defined measurably, through the orientation-concentration and coverage statistics reported in Section 5, rather than asserted qualitatively. The framework generates multiple synchronized annotation formats, including YOLO oriented bounding boxes, point annotations, density maps, and polarization-based renderings (AoLP and DoLP images), while maintaining strict reproducibility through seeded random number generation; the annotations are exact by construction, and the derived density-map targets pass a density-integral self-consistency check to within 2 % 2\% . For the second research question on supporting camera-based quality assurance methods, the results demonstrate that the synthetic datasets successfully replicate key industrial characteristics: temporal density evolution profiles show realistic strip accumulation and steady-state packing behavior matching the balance between strip count and belt speed, while fiber orientation distribution analysis confirms near-isotropic behavior consistent with commercial SMC sheets (axial orientation concentration r = 0.047 r=0.047 for the dataset as a whole, with training pool and held-out test split closely matching). The AoLP renderings accurately capture orientation information across different manufacturing stages, providing suitable ground truth for validating detection algorithms and training orientation-sensitive networks. Addressing the third research question on machine learning training and validation, YOLOv11 for object detection and CSRNet for density estimation were trained exclusively on synthetic data and benchmarked on held-out synthetic splits (detection mAP 50 \text{mAP}_{50} up to 0.91 0.91 across model scales, with a dedicated oriented-bounding-box detector confirming that the oriented labels are themselves directly trainable at mAP 50 = 0.83 \text{mAP}_{50}=0.83 ; count estimation strongest in the mid-density regime); on real manufacturing images, the label-free distributional distance between synthetic and real frames in edge and texture structure is of the same magnitude as the distance between two real acquisition series of the same material (Table 4 ), and the synthetic-trained density model produces temporally consistent, non-collapsing count predictions on a steady real run. The residual synthetic-to-real gap is characterized rather than assumed away (a polarization calibration offset, a denser-than-real coverage regime, and unmodelled background), and the automated generation pipeline enables the rapid, augmentation-based refinement described in Section 5.4 , substantially reducing the labeling burden compared to manual annotation while maintaining the ability to bootstrap model development entirely from synthetic data.
blocks.zh: 这项工作通过为C-SMC条形沉降开发和验证一个过程知情、光现实化的数字双胞胎,解决所有三个研究问题。 关于生成硅化物中大规模、充分注解的图像数据集的第一个研究问题,所开发的模拟框架显示,有能力制作超过16 000 16{,} 000幅超过3 300 3{,}300个有综合说明的测量框架的图像,通过刚性体条状沉积动态捕捉到中间和宏观的纤维排列变异性,其中包含重力沉积、摩擦和带状运动;这种变异性是通过第5节中报告的定向集中和覆盖统计,而不是定性的。 框架生成多个同步的注释格式,包括YOLO面向边框,点说明,密度图,以及基于极化的渲染(AOLP和DOLP图像),同时通过种子随机数生成保持严格的重制性;注释通过构造精确,所衍生的密度-映射目标通过密度-整体自相容性检查到2%-2%-%之内. 关于支持基于相机的质量保证方法的第二个研究问题,结果显示,合成数据集成功地复制了关键的工业特征:时间密度演化剖面显示现实的条状累积和稳定状态的包装行为,匹配了条状计数和带状速度之间的平衡,而纤维定向分布分析则确认与商业SMC表一致的近异性行为(整个数据集的轴向浓度r=0.047 r=0.047,培训池和停放测试分裂紧密匹配). AOLP渲染精准地捕捉不同制造阶段的定向信息,为验证检测算法和培训定向敏感网络提供了合适的地面真理. 针对关于机器学习培训和验证的第三个研究问题,YOLOv11用于物体检测和CSRNet用于密度估计的培训完全针对合成数据,并以被搁置的合成分裂为基准(检测mAP 50\text{mAP}_{50}在模型尺度上最高可达0.91 0.91,其中专用的定向框探测器证实,定向标签本身可在mAP 50=0.83\text{mAP}_{50\\0.83;在中密度制度中最强的计数估计);在实际制造图像上,在边缘合成框架与真实框架之间的无标签分布距离和纹理结构与同一材料的两个真实获取系列之间的距离(表4)相同,合成训练密度模型在稳定真实运行时产生时间一致的、非碰撞的计数预测。 剩余合成-实际差距的特征是而非被假定为已去掉(两极分化校准抵消、密度大于实际覆盖制度和未建模的背景),自动生成管道使第5.4节所述的快速、基于增强的改进得以进行,大大减轻了与人工注释相比的标签负担,同时保持完全通过合成数据开发模型的能力。

blocks.en: 6 Outlook
blocks.zh: 6 展望

blocks.en: Future work will focus on enhancing the realism and utility of synthetic data for fiber orientation analysis and anomaly detection in SMC inspection. One key area is improving the representation of fiber orientations, particularly capturing the non-uniform distributions observed in real-world scenarios, which are critical for robust anomaly detection. Additionally, boundary conditions in synthetic datasets will be refined to better reflect operational realities. For example, training data should include strips partially exiting the measurement volume, in line with the sliding window inference paradigm used during deployment. This can be achieved through adjustments to camera framing or by expanding the spawn volume beyond the nominal measurement box.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作将侧重于加强合成数据的现实性和实用性,用于纤维定向分析和在工作人员监测委员会检查中发现异常情况。 一个关键领域是改善纤维定向的表示,特别是捕捉在现实世界情景中观察到的非统一分布,这对于强力异常探测至关重要。 此外,将改进合成数据集中的边界条件,以更好地反映业务现实。 例如,培训数据应包含部分退出测量量的条条,以符合部署期间使用的滑动窗口推论范式。 这可以通过调整照相机架设或将产卵量扩大到标称的测量框之外来实现。

blocks.en: Another important direction is increasing lighting diversity. The synthetic data generation pipeline will be expanded to include directional illumination at varying angles (0°–45° from vertical), a wider range of intensities (50–200% of baseline), and both hard and soft shadows, to better capture real-world variability. Similarly, material appearance will be refined to reduce the gap with real imagery. Adjustments may include increased surface roughness, moderate variations in grayscale tone, and enhanced fiber texture detail using normal mapping to simulate surface irregularities.
blocks.zh: 另一个重要方向是增加照明多样性。 合成数据生成管道将扩大,包括不同角度的方向照明(从垂直角度0~~45°),更广泛的强度(基线的50~200%),以及硬阴影和软阴影,以便更好地捕捉现实世界的变异性. 同样,将改进物质外观,以缩小与真实图像的差距。 调整可能包括:表面粗糙度增加,灰度音调的微小变化,以及利用正常的映射来模拟表面异常的纤维纹理细节增强.

blocks.en: Background variation will also be addressed by incorporating diverse textures and colors representative of different conveyor belt materials, such as gray, blue, or black surfaces with smooth or textured finishes, rather than the current uniform gray background. Finally, extreme density scenarios will be more heavily represented in the training data. The strip counts studied here were chosen for the degree of strip overlap they induce rather than for the count alone; higher counts additionally raise the incidence of directly adjacent, equally oriented rovings, which merge visually and form the hardest case for both detection and orientation estimation. Including cases with very high strip counts (>900) will better prepare models for these worst-case real-world conditions, as current datasets emphasize moderate densities for computational efficiency.
blocks.zh: 还将通过纳入不同传送带材料,如灰色、蓝色或黑色表面,具有光滑或纹理精度的纹理和颜色,而不是当前统一的灰色背景,来应对背景变化。 最后,在培训数据中将更多地反映极端密度的情况。 此处研究的条纹计数是根据其诱导的条纹重叠程度,而不是单为计数;较高的计数还增加了直接相邻,同样面向的曲纹的发生率,这些曲纹在视觉上合并,成为探测和定向估计最难的例. 包括非常高的条形计数(>900)的案件,将更好地为这些最坏的实际情况准备模型,因为当前的数据集强调计算效率的密度适中。

blocks.en: Together, these planned improvements aim to increase the realism of synthetic training data and, in turn, enhance the reliability and performance of machine learning models for fiber orientation analysis and anomaly detection in SMC applications.
blocks.zh: 这些计划中的改进措施共同旨在提高合成培训数据的现实性,并进而提高用于纤维定向分析和SMC应用中的异常检测的机器学习模型的可靠性和性能.

blocks.en: Code and Data Availability
blocks.zh: 代码和数据提供情况

blocks.en: The complete digital-twin pipeline, comprising the rigid-body deposition simulation, the polarization rendering model, the multi-format annotation generation, and the training and evaluation code for the YOLOv11 and YOLO11-OBB detectors and the CSRNet density model, is released as open-source software under the Apache License 2.0. The repository is hosted on GitHub ( github.com/PatRuediger/c-smc-digital-twin ), and a versioned, archived snapshot will be deposited on Zenodo, with the DOI provided for the camera-ready version. It documents the configuration schema, the SQLite database schema and on-disk file layout, and the tunable physics and appearance parameters (friction, restitution, damping, and the polarization and lighting settings), and includes a small example dataset of representative rendered frames together with their oriented-box, point, and density-map annotations, sufficient to run the pipeline end to end and to regenerate a representative figure. The full generated corpus (over 3,300 3{,}300 rendered measurement frames, of which 3,145 3{,}145 carry complete annotations) is available from the authors on reasonable request.
blocks.zh: 完整的数字双管,包括刚体沉积模拟,极化渲染模型,多格式注释生成,以及YOLOv11和YOLO11-OBB探测器的训练和评价代码以及CSRNet密度模型,在Apache许可证2.0下作为开源软件发布. 该寄存器在GitHub(github.com/PatRuediger/c-smc-digital-twin)上托管,一个版本的存档快照将存放在泽诺多,DOI为相机准备的版本提供. 它记录了配置图、SQLite数据库图和磁盘文件布局,以及金枪鱼物理和表型参数(软体、还原、筑坝、两极分化和照明设置),并包括了代表性框架的小型示例数据集及其导向框、点和密度图说明,足以将管道末端运行到结束并重新生成一个代表性数字。 经提交人合理要求,可提供完整的生成体(超过3 300 3{,}300个制作的测量框架,其中3 145 3{,}145个附有完整的说明)。
